Thank you for the feedback!
Our current website for the Bay Area locations, San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA, is [URL_001].

We therefore want [URL_002] to serve as our master site, bringing our brand, locations, and information together in one place. It should include sublinks for each location while enabling every location to track its own bookings, revenue, and sales separately.

Thank you for clarifying; that makes complete sense.

A single master website for the Smash Room brand, with individual pages for each location, is definitely the right solution. Everything can remain within one website while each location independently manages its own Wix Bookings, appointments, and revenue.

I reviewed [URL_001] as well, so I understand the branding and structural direction you want for the new site. This arrangement will also simplify adding more locations in the future as the franchise expands.

Before proceeding, I have one question: is [URL_002] already established in Wix, with the goal of having me rebrand and restructure that existing site, or do you want me to create the new master site from scratch while using your current website as a reference?

Your answer will allow me to confirm the scope. If everything is aligned, I can begin immediately and provide updates throughout the project.

I would like to create smash [URL_003] from scratch while using the same general type of template. We are beginning to franchise, so we need to be able to integrate new locations while still giving them full control.
We really like the layout of one of our competitors. It is simple, displays each location, and is easy to navigate.

I agree that this is the best approach for a franchise that is expanding.

Creating [URL_002] from the ground up will provide a strong foundation that can be expanded much more easily whenever new locations are added. We can organize the site so every location has a dedicated page and remains able to manage its own Wix Bookings, appointments, and business independently, while everything stays under the main Smash Room brand.

Considering everything we've discussed, I would normally charge $600 for a project like this because it involves a brand-new franchise website, a multi-location setup, and independent booking management.

That said, I'm willing to work within your budget and find an arrangement that suits both of us.
My budget is around $400, and I’ll definitely come back for future locations!
Thank you—I appreciate that and value the chance to work together over the long term. I can accommodate the $400 budget, and we'll create the website in a way that makes adding future locations easy.

My estimate for a project of this scope is 10–14 business days. This timeframe allows me to properly develop the new website, set up booking for multiple locations, test the entire site thoroughly, and complete any necessary revisions.

Step 1: Access your Wix account

Navigate to My Sites.

Locate the new website.


Step 2: Link the old domain to the new website

1. Enter the new website's Dashboard.


2. Navigate to Settings → Domains.


3. Choose Connect Existing Domain (or Assign Domain).


4. Pick the domain that is currently linked to the old website.


5. Approve moving the domain over to the new website.



Step 3: Set it as the primary domain

When prompted, designate the moved domain as the Primary Domain.


Step 4: Allow time for the update

The domain generally begins working after a few minutes, though in certain cases the change may take up to 48 hours.


Important

The old website will not be deleted; only its domain connection will be removed.

The new website will become the live site that visitors see when they go to the domain
